title: Ngā Māra o te Whai Hua e Ngaro Ana
intro: I roto i tētahi whenua i manaakitia ki te hua nui, i tupu te hapori, e noho ana i waenganui i ngā tohu o te aroha noa o te Atua. Ko tō rātou rawa he tohu i te manaakitanga o tō rātou Ariki, he taonga hei whakaoho i te whakawhetai me te ngohengohe. Heoi, ahakoa ngā tohu mārama o ō rātou manaakitanga, i tae mai tētahi wā hurihanga, e wero ana i tō rātou maioha ki te pūtake o ō rātou taonga nui me te whakamarie.
clues: I manaakitia mātou ki ngā māra e rua, tētahi i te taha matau, tētahi i te taha maui, he nui ngā hua.
I whakahaua tātou kia kai i ngā mea i homai e tō tātou Ariki, kia whakawhetai hoki ki a Ia mō te whenua pai, me te Ariki muru hara.
I whakakake mātou, i tahuri ke atu i te ara o te whakawhetai, i te whakamanamana ki ō mātou taonga me te mana.
I tono mātou kia whakanuia e te Ariki te tawhiti i waenganui i ā mātou haerenga, hei whakaatu i tōna whakahawea ki te ngāwari i homai e Ia.
I whakatūpatohia mātou e tētahi karere, engari i whakakahoretia e mātou te karere, ā, i haere tonu mātou i roto i tō mātou mangere.
I te mutunga, i pakaru tō mātou tāwharau nui, te mea i tautoko i tō mātou whai rawa, ka arahina atu ki tētahi waipuke nui.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te whakaekenga a te ope taua nui
He waipuke whakangaro mai i tētahi tāke pakaru
Te tukino a te rangatira nanakia
trial.answer: He waipuke whakangaro mai i tētahi tāke pakaru

outcome.label: Hua
options: I hurihia mātou hei makimaki me hei poaka
I whakaorangia mātou, ā, i heke ki tētahi whenua hou
I marara noa atu mātou, ā, i pakoko haere tō mātou whenua
I piki mātou ki te rangi
I hanga e mātou he kingitanga hou, he rangatiratanga whai rawa ake
outcome.answer: I marara noa atu mātou, ā, i pakoko haere tō mātou whenua

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
